main_text.p: kamen aliqua, exemplaris, quo usus est vir doctissi-mus, non satis correcti vitio, errores aliquot irrepse-rint, non inutile visum est ea sive conjectura, sive ali-orum librorum ope restituta, lectoris oculis hoc lo-co subjicere.
main_text.head: CENT. I.
main_text.p: Prov. 1. لا تركب فرسا غيرك Ne equites equum alienum. Constructionis ratio postulat ut legatur فرسا لغيرك vel فرس غيرك. Sonant enim verba prout leguntur, Ne equites equum prater teipsum.

Prov. 60. املك الانسان لنفسه من كتم سره Possidet homo animam suam (vel seipsum) qui occultat secretum suum ab amico suo. من صديقه [?] S. videtur potius uertendum, Dominatur homo anima sua vel sibi ipsi, &c. Erp.] In MS. fuisse الناس [?] AlNafo [in Nominativo] dicit Erpenius, quod ille mendosum suspicatus, legit الانسان Alensan. at vera lectio est النفس [?] AlNafsi [Genitivi casus] & proverbium ita reddendum, Maximè ille, inter homines, possidet animam suam, vel, Maximam ille, hominum, in se[vel sui] potestatem habet, qui occultat secretum suum ab amico suo. املك الناس لنفسه [?] AlMaidani [?] Maximam, inter homines, sui potestatem habet, qui maximè tegit secretum suum. يضرب في مثل [?] كتمان السر {*}Laudatur hoc dicto qui secreta optimè celare novit. Adverb occul-tatio secret. confer. Cent. 2. prov. 54.
Prov. 91. غدن الصباح يحمد القوم الهدي [?] Ad auroram laudas populus pluviam. Pro الهدى [?] quod

page.notes: Arabic words are copied from a small, low-resolution scan; those marked [?] are doubtful. The Arabic in the Prov. 60 and Prov. 91 lines, and the transliterated names (AlNafo, Alensan, AlNafsi, AlMaidani), are read as well as the scan allows. The first word is a fragment ("kamen") because the page begins mid-word. No running head and no gathering signature are printed.
